title: Nutrition guidance and cardiovascular health
text:
Dr. Stacey Rosen, American Heart Association (AHA) president, who is a cardiologist and a senior vice president of women’s health at Northwell Health in New York, said the government’s encouragement to eat red meat and full-fat dairy products could hurt people’s health. “It has been shown repeatedly to be a not healthy way to eat,” she said.

The current administration’s recommendations are at odds with major medical experts and decades of research! I am with the doctors rather than the politicians!
